articles.summary: This is the first in a four-part series adapted from my assessment, “The New Mission Relevant Terrain,” which examines AI-enabled cyber threats to U.S. national security and the defenses they demand. Our focus is on how people and intelligent systems work together to strengthen mission decisions.
articles.title: The Model Is Not the Weapon: Why Cyber Defense Begins With the Data

articles.summary: Key Takeaways:Super Intelligence can reduce cognitive load and accelerate mission decisions when capabilities remain trusted, resilient and explainable.Effective human-machine teams combine orchestrated models with authoritative mission knowledge and experienced human judgment.
articles.title: Operationalizing the Era of Super Intelligence
